definitions.explanation: Polite/formal form of いい. Used to grant permission or express approval.
Used to confirm that something meets standards or is acceptable.

examples.japanese: これでよろしいですか。
examples.english: Is this all right? / Will this do?

examples.japanese: {入|はい}ってもよろしいですか。
ご{注文|ちゅうもん}はこれでよろしいでしょうか。
examples.english: Is this your complete order? / Is this correct for your order?

notes:
よろしい is an i-adjective that serves as the formal/honorific equivalent of いい (good).

Forms:
- Adverbial: よろしく (also used in greetings)
- Note: Noun form よろしさ is not commonly used

Conjugation:
- Negative: よろしくない
- Te-form: よろしくて
- Past: よろしかった

[Register: Formal/Honorific]

Similar words:
- よろしい vs. いい: よろしい is more formal and polite. いい is neutral/casual.

Note: よろしく is frequently used in the set phrase よろしくお{願|ねが}いします (Please treat me favorably / Nice to meet you).

Orthography: Usually written in hiragana. The kanji {宜|よろ}しい exists but is rarely used.
